package.description: restic is a backup program which allows saving multiple revisions of files and directories in an encrypted repository stored on different backends (position independent)
package.name: restic

pipeline.name: Fetch the locked source commit
pipeline.runs:
git init -q .
for delay in 0 15 45; do
  sleep "$delay"
  for source in https://github.com/restic/restic; do
    if git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -c fetch.fsckObjects=true fetch --no-tags --depth=1 "$source" 6aa3a516ce654808a1f28f9fa21e9b7c8e6e90bf; then
      test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = 6aa3a516ce654808a1f28f9fa21e9b7c8e6e90bf
      git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null checkout -q --detach 6aa3a516ce654808a1f28f9fa21e9b7c8e6e90bf
      exit 0
    fi
  done
done
echo "6aa3a516ce654808a1f28f9fa21e9b7c8e6e90bf: every source failed, three times" >&2
exit 1

with.deps:
go.opentelemetry.io/otel@v1.45.0
go.opentelemetry.io/otel/metric@v1.45.0
go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk@v1.45.0
go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/metric@v1.45.0
go.opentelemetry.io/otel/trace@v1.45.0
google.golang.org/grpc@v1.83.2
golang.org/x/net@v0.60.0
golang.org/x/sync@v0.22.0
golang.org/x/sys@v0.48.0
golang.org/x/text@v0.42.0
golang.org/x/crypto@v0.57.0
golang.org/x/term@v0.46.0

subpackages.description: Compatibility package to place binaries in the location expected by upstream helm charts
subpackages.name: ${{package.name}}-compat

pipeline.runs:
# The helm chart expects the binaries to be in / instead of /usr/bin
mkdir -p "${{targets.subpkgdir}}"
ln -sf /usr/bin/restic ${{targets.subpkgdir}}/restic

pipeline.name: Test backup and restore workflow
pipeline.runs:
set -euo pipefail

export RESTIC_PASSWORD=testpassword
export RESTIC_REPOSITORY=/tmp/test-repo

# Initialize a local repository
restic init
stat /tmp/test-repo/config

# Create test data
mkdir -p /tmp/testdata/subdir
echo 'test content' > /tmp/testdata/file.txt
echo 'nested content' > /tmp/testdata/subdir/nested.txt

# Create a backup
restic backup /tmp/testdata

# List snapshots and verify the backup exists
restic snapshots | grep -F "/tmp/testdata"

# Verify repository integrity
restic check

# Restore data and verify integrity
restic restore latest --target /tmp/restored
grep -F 'test content' /tmp/restored/tmp/testdata/file.txt
grep -F 'nested content' /tmp/restored/tmp/testdata/subdir/nested.txt

echo "SUCCESS: Backup and restore workflow completed"
